idea: Move sail crates into colored harbors by rotating their sails and releasing global wind gusts. Clicks select or rotate a sail crate, direction keys move the worker, and Space blows wind one step in the current wind direction. A sail crate moves only if its sail faces the wind, while sideways sails act as blockers; crates can block each other, press pads, or shield other crates from gusts. Levels should teach single-crate wind movement, rotating sails to stop motion, using one crate as a windbreak, staging several crates before a gust, changing wind direction with corner fans, and final harbors where the same crate must be blocker, passenger, and pad-holder at different times.
title: Wind Sails
